title: Cross-region retention controls and automated evidence pipeline for prompt/response/request data
creator: Asha Kapoor
description:
Summary: Build tenant-scoped, region-aware retention controls and an automated evidence export pipeline for request artifacts (prompts, model responses, request metadata/logs, and aggregate metrics). The feature will let customers set per-tenant and per-route retention policies that differ by data category and region, generate cryptographically verifiable evidence bundles for audits, and provide console UX + APIs to manage and preview retention behavior.

Goals:
- Tenant-level retention presets for each artifact type: prompts, responses, request logs (headers/metadata), and aggregated metrics.
- Per-region residency toggle to pin persisted artifacts to a region or replicate for multi-region retention where permitted.
- Policy inheritance and overrides: org-default -> tenant -> route.
- Automated evidence export that pulls a time-bounded bundle with provenance metadata (policy id, retention decision, deletion hashes) suitable for auditors. Support both scheduled snapshots and on-demand exports.
- Role-gated console workflows for creating and approving retention changes (audit trail + SSO integration).

Non-goals for this ticket:
- Full legal compliance assessments per country (we'll provide tooling and evidence; customers responsible for policy choice).
- PST/archival cold storage pipeline (handled by a follow-up infra ticket).

Technical constraints and considerations:
- Retention enforcement must be enforced in both Hosted and Dedicated modes; Private deployments may require an operator flag for automated evidence uploads.
- Deletion flows should be idempotent and provide a reversible audit log for 30 days (soft-delete window) before permanent purge when policy requires immediate deletion.
- Evidence bundles must include signed manifests with model version, sequence of deletion operations (if any), and the policy snapshot that led to the action.
- Need coordination with ENG on efficient deletion of KV cache snapshots vs persisted logs to avoid service disruptions.

Acceptance criteria:
- Console: UI to define retention policy with separate sliders/fields for prompts, responses, request logs, and metrics. Support region selector and policy preview for sample traffic.
- API: endpoints to create/update/delete tenant retention policies, and to request an evidence export for a time range.
- Enforcement: requests older than policy window are not returned by retrieval APIs; deleted persisted objects removed from long-term storage per policy.
- Evidence export: generated bundle downloadable from console/API, includes signed manifest and a CSV/JSON index of artifacts and retention decisions.
- Tests: E2E test demonstrating policy inheritance, per-route override, cross-region residency toggle, and successful evidence export.

Privacy note: ensure PII scrub rules are available as part of the policy UI (opt-in redaction templates) to allow customers to choose automatic redaction for sensitive fields prior to retention or export.
acceptance_criteria: Console: create and apply tenant-level policy covering prompts/responses/logs/metrics with region selection and policy preview
API: create/update/delete retention policy and request evidence export for a time range
Enforcement: retrieval APIs and console previews reflect retention windows accurately; deleted data removed from long-term storage per policy
Evidence export: downloadable bundle contains signed manifest, policy snapshot, and index of artifacts with retention decisions
Tests: automated E2E test for inheritance, per-route override, and evidence export success
comments: 2026-03-01 - Asha Kapoor: Created ticket to centralize retention controls and evidence automation across artifacts. Initial PRD linked.
2026-03-03 - Marco Li: Scoped into two phases: Phase 1 (console + API + evidence export pipeline for hosted) and Phase 2 (Dedicated/Private parity + infra deletes). Estimated Phase 1 at 5 points.
2026-03-05 - Eng (Ravi Menon): Noted risk around purging KV-cache-aligned snapshots; proposed soft-delete window default of 30 days to avoid cache incoherence. Added ENG-2879 as dependency.
2026-03-07 - Privacy (Elena García): Suggested adding standard redaction templates (PII, PCI-like patterns) to be selectable in the policy to reduce sensitive data retained in evidence bundles.
2026-03-09 - Design (Lina Park): Shared initial console mockups — added toggle for regional residency and a timeline preview. UX flagged need for clear language about legal responsibility.

2026-03-11 - Marco Li: Decided to make evidence exports signed with a server key and include a verification endpoint. Also decided evidence bundles will include a compact provenance manifest rather than full raw payloads by default; raw payloads available only when "always-raw" option is enabled by tenant and redaction rules applied.
2026-03-12 - Security (Omar Chen): Requested a security review; flagged requirement to support KMS-backed signing for enterprise tenants. Marked security_review_required=true.
2026-03-13 - Asha Kapoor: Updated acceptance criteria to require E2E tests. Moved ticket to Planned and assigned to Marco Li for kickoff
